locations.name: Campess Port
locations.blurb: Where the heroes stepped off the boat. Doppelgangers, goblins, a hidden temple and the first inquisitor to fall.

locations.name: The river road
locations.blurb: A sea hag, a mad sea goddess and the Barely Cursed Bazaar.

locations.name: Muttonham
locations.blurb: Market town, church-free since Session 12. Held against Auril's army.

locations.name: Nogratis Pass
locations.blurb: Modron ticket offices, a haunted train and a werewolf dinner party.

locations.name: The caves under the pass
locations.blurb: Hugo's shortcut. It was not a shortcut.

locations.name: Nogratis
locations.blurb: A university town under frost. An enema, a werewolf and a very fair trial.

locations.name: Mt Mistmourne
locations.blurb: Nyxara's citadel. Two heroes went up and did not come down.

locations.name: The swamp below Mt Mistmourne
locations.blurb: A prison full of modrons, and D.E.R.E.K.

locations.name: Fireholm
locations.blurb: Agni's old heart. The Concrete Tree, the Grand Arena and an unreasonable number of sewers.

locations.name: Fireholm Prison
locations.blurb: Where Fiddle was freed and Gavin was not.

locations.name: Frostfall Fortress
locations.blurb: The old Brotherhood outpost on the Cinderflow ravine, and its vampires.

locations.name: The source of the Cinderflow
locations.blurb: Teller, the Floating Sanctuary, Agni's trials and his Scales.

locations.name: The Temporal Anomaly
locations.blurb: Somewhere between Fireholm and Muttonham, the fog rolled in and time stopped behaving.
